summary: Submitted the fixed-input experiment for the recovery/resync failure: a deterministic single-threaded harness (draft/assurance_generated.rs, installed as omnipaxos/tests/assurance_generated.rs) drives three real OmniPaxos instances to the state where a crash-recovered node has accepted 6 / decided 3 while the healthy follower has compacted to 6, then has the stale node attempt a takeover. It asserts the prefix and reports the follower's log-update outcome as a CA_EVENT; the same harness ran locally and reported outcome "aborted_panic" (attempt to subtract with overflow). Execution requested so the account can move from conditional/unresolved to a retained receipt.
